name: extrapolation_bench
description: A small suite designed to evaluate models' extrapolation capabilities: predicting beyond the training distribution on synthetic or structured tasks (e.g., sequences, functions, or numerical patterns). It targets how well models generalize to inputs larger or different than seen during training, measuring both prediction accuracy and robustness. The tasks emphasize systematic generalization and out-of-distribution performance.
reputation: A niche, experimental benchmark with limited community adoption used primarily for research into extrapolation and OOD generalization.
